spec.rawSql:
WITH target_instrument AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM instruments
  WHERE id IN ($instrument)
)

SELECT
  o.start_time AS time,
  o.end_time AS timeEnd,
  t.name || ' OFF' AS title,
  'SEM server offline' AS text
FROM em_off o
JOIN target_instrument t
  ON o.instrument_id = t.id

spec.title: Avg cryo cycle duration
spec.description: For Aquilos, we calculate the time periods when the temperature is above 0C

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
        start_time,
        end_time,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(end_time - start_time)) AS total_duration
    FROM sem_cryocycle_al_daily,
        state_periods(agg, 1) -- boolean = 1 where value = CryoCycle
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND param_name = 'Column'
      AND $__timeFilter(day)

SELECT
        start_time,
        end_time,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(end_time - start_time)) AS total_duration
    FROM sem_cryocycle_noal_daily,
        state_periods(agg, 1) -- boolean = 1 where value > 0
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND $__timeFilter(day)

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'TempCtrl'
    AND param_name = 'Lcldwr'
),

bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('30 seconds', d.time) AS bucket,
    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY bucket
),

lagged AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    avg_value,
    LAG(avg_value, 1) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_1,
    LAG(avg_value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_2,
    LAG(avg_value, 3) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_3
  FROM bucketed
),

labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_value > 90 AND (val_1 < 90 OR val_1 IS NULL) THEN true
      WHEN avg_value >= COALESCE(val_1, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_2, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_3, -1e9)
       AND avg_value > 90 THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS is_peak
  FROM lagged
),

with_peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN is_peak AND NOT LAG(is_peak, 1, false) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS new_peak_start
  FROM labeled
),

peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(new_peak_start) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS peak_group_id
  FROM with_peak_groups
),

ranked_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value,
    peak_group_id,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY peak_group_id ORDER BY avg_value DESC) AS val_rank
  FROM peak_groups
  WHERE is_peak
),

collapsed_peaks AS (
  SELECT time
  FROM ranked_peaks
  WHERE val_rank = 1
),

with_deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_time
  FROM collapsed_peaks
),

deltas AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - prev_time)) AS sec_between
  FROM with_deltas
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT AVG(sec_between) AS avg_sec_between_refills
FROM deltas;

spec.title: Base vacuum
spec.description: HVG pressure when the chamber is pumped

spec.rawSql:
WITH chamber_state_param AS (
    SELECT param_id, enum_id
    FROM parameters
    WHERE 
        instrument_id = $instrument
        AND subsystem = 'Vacuum'
        AND component = 'Chamber'
        AND param_name = 'Chamber.StateSC'
),
pumped_value AS (
    SELECT 
        e.value AS pumped_value_num,
        p.param_id
    FROM chamber_state_param p
    JOIN enum_values e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
    WHERE e.member_name = 'Pumped'
),
raw_states AS (
    SELECT state_agg(v.time, v.value_num::bigint) AS agg
    FROM data v
    JOIN chamber_state_param p ON p.param_id = v.param_id
    WHERE v.instrument_id = $instrument
      AND $__timeFilter(v.time)
),
pumped_states AS (
    SELECT start_time, end_time
    FROM state_periods(
        (SELECT agg FROM raw_states),
        (SELECT pumped_value_num FROM pumped_value)::bigint
        )
),
pressure_param AS (
    SELECT param_id
    FROM parameters
    WHERE 
      instrument_id = $instrument
      AND component = 'Chamber'
      AND param_name = 'Chamber.HVG'
),
pressure_values AS (
    SELECT 
        v.time,
        v.value_num AS pressure_value
    FROM data v
    JOIN pressure_param p ON p.param_id = v.param_id
    JOIN pumped_states r 
        ON v.time >= r.start_time 
        AND v.time <= r.end_time
    WHERE 
        v.instrument_id = $instrument
)
SELECT
    time,
    approx_percentile(
        0.5,
        percentile_agg(pressure_value)
            OVER (
                ORDER BY time
                RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '24 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            )
    ) AS "Rolling 24-hour median HVG pressure"
FROM pressure_values
ORDER BY time;

WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND component = 'Service'
    AND param_name = 'PVP1Lifetime'
)

  SELECT d.value_num
  FROM data d
  JOIN counter_param p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  ORDER BY d.time DESC
  LIMIT 1

WITH cagg AS (
  SELECT
    p.enum_id,
    state_agg(d.time, d.value_num :: int) AS agg
  FROM
    data d
    JOIN parameters p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND p.component = 'Chamber'
    AND p.param_name = 'Chamber.Mode'
  GROUP BY
    p.enum_id
)

SELECT
  ev.member_name AS state,
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM
  cagg
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL state_int_timeline(agg) s
  JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = cagg.enum_id AND ev.value = s.state
GROUP BY ev.member_name
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

SELECT
  hour AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "1-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_hourly
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'Quickloader.QLG'
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "24-hour average"
FROM sem_pressure_daily
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'Quickloader.QLG'
  AND $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day

WITH cagg AS (
  SELECT
    p.enum_id,
    state_agg(d.time, d.value_num :: int) AS agg
  FROM
    data d
    JOIN parameters p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND p.component = 'Stage'
    AND p.param_name = 'ActiveHolder'
  GROUP BY
    p.enum_id
)

SELECT
  ev.member_name AS "Holder",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM
  cagg
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL state_int_timeline(agg) s
  JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = cagg.enum_id AND ev.value = s.state
GROUP BY ev.member_name
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

WITH param_ids AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND subsystem = 'Options'
    AND component = 'Thermometers'
    AND param_name LIKE 'ExperimentalThermometerCryo%Temperature'
)
SELECT
    time_bucket_gapfill('1 hour', d.time) AS time,
    p.param_name,
    locf(approx_percentile(0.5, percentile_agg(d.value_num))) AS median_1h
FROM data d
JOIN param_ids p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
    p.param_name,
    COUNT(*) AS bad_count
FROM data d
JOIN parameters p 
    ON d.param_id = p.param_id
    AND p.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND p.subsystem = 'Vacuum'
    AND p.component = 'Interlocks'
JOIN enum_values e
    ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
    AND e.value = d.value_num
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND e.member_name IN ('Interlock BAD', 'Disabled')
GROUP BY p.param_name
ORDER BY p.param_name

WITH cagg AS (
  SELECT
    p.enum_id,
    state_agg(d.time, d.value_num :: int) AS agg
  FROM
    data d
    JOIN parameters p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND p.component = 'Chamber'
    AND p.param_name = 'Chamber.StateSC'
  GROUP BY
    p.enum_id
)

SELECT
  ev.member_name AS "State",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM
  cagg
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL state_int_timeline(agg) s
  JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = cagg.enum_id AND ev.value = s.state
GROUP BY ev.member_name
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id,
    enum_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_name = 'Buffer.BufferState'
    AND subsystem = 'Vacuum'
),

state_enum AS (
  SELECT e.member_name, e.value
  FROM
    enum_values e
    JOIN state_param p USING (enum_id)
),

durations AS (
  SELECT
    e.member_name AS state,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time-start_time)) AS duration
  FROM
    state_int_timeline(
      (
        SELECT
          state_agg(d.time, d.value_num :: bigint) AS agg
        FROM
          data d
          JOIN state_param p USING (param_id)
        WHERE
          d.instrument_id = $instrument
          AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
          AND d.value_num != 0 -- filter out zeros
      )
    )
  JOIN state_enum e ON e.value = state
)

SELECT
  AVG(duration) FILTER (WHERE state = 'Overflow') AS "Avg duration",
  AVG(duration) FILTER (WHERE state = 'OK')  AS "Avg time between cycles"
FROM durations

WITH total AS (
  SELECT
    gis_port,
    MAX(day) AS last_day,
    last_val(rollup(agg)) AS total_usage
  FROM gis_counters_daily
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(day) 
  GROUP BY gis_port
),

daily AS (
  SELECT
    gis_port,
    AVG(delta(agg)) AS daily_avg
  FROM gis_counters_daily
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND $__timeFilter(day)
    GROUP BY gis_port
)

SELECT
  t.gis_port AS "Port",
  COALESCE(d.daily_avg, 0) AS "Daily usage",
  t.total_usage/3600.0 AS "Total usage (h)",
  t.total_usage/3600.0/120*100 AS "Total usage (%)"
FROM total t
LEFT JOIN daily d USING (gis_port)
ORDER BY t.gis_port
